name: Upper Onion Creek Campground (Fisher Towers, Moab)
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 251835 (295 days observed, edges opens+closes)
note: BLM campground on a bench above Onion Creek near the Fisher Towers, 1.5 miles up gravel from SR-128 (22 miles up the Colorado River road from US-191 north of Moab), with red-rock and La Sal views. 14 first-come, first-served sites (cash or check) plus two reservable group sites; toilets, no hookups. Reviewers have brought fifth wheels and Class As of 32-40 ft. The Onion Creek 4WD road starts here - flash floods in the monsoon. --Claude
